operations.title: Intrinsic-prime scattering is unitary only before the continuation gate
operations.statement: For Re(s)>1 the source-derived prime diagonal N gives D(s)=det(I-N^-s)=1/zeta(s), and S_sigma(t)=D(sigma+it)/D(sigma-it) is a unitary scalar scattering phase whose logarithmic derivative is twice the real prime-power trace. The operator ceases to be trace class for sigma<=1 and is not Hilbert-Schmidt at sigma=1/2. Recovering the zeta continuation from a higher regularized determinant requires a new renormalization law; choosing it from zeta itself is circular.
operations.scope: Exact in the Fredholm convergence half-plane and an audit of the critical-line obstruction; no claim that classical meromorphic continuation fails.

operations.title: Critical-line Schatten and circularity audit
operations.description: Check trace-class and Hilbert-Schmidt sums for the prime diagonal, compute the unitary determinant ratio and its phase derivative, and identify which deleted Euler terms a regularized determinant would require.
